# backendtest

```go
import "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/backendtest"
```

Package backendtest checks that a gashe.Backend keeps the contract every strategy relies on.

Call Run from a test of your backend. newBackend must return an empty backend for every subtest; subtests do not run in parallel, so they may share one server. The suite never waits for real time to pass: expiry itself is the backend's own business and is not tested here.
